purpose: Repair reference-angle sensitivity and transient dilution; development experiment, not independent confirmation
data: Unchanged 32 records and conservative families from data/diagnosis/manifest.json
selection: Keep original channels, segment bounds and labels; no outcome-driven relabeling or exclusions
representation: One offset-invariant 13-feature event-shape vector per 90-sample original segment
features: maximum increment to median absolute deviation ratio
training: 300-tree Random Forest seed 42; equal total weight per class, then family, then recording; inner selection among min_samples_leaf 1,3,5
evaluation: Same 3 outer family-grouped folds; inner grouped selection and unchanged 95% per-returned-class precision target; publish all forced and abstained outcomes
stop_rule: One specified candidate; no feature or parameter changes driven by its outer results
limitations: Previously examined data are development data. Three timing families, source recording labels, potential provider confounding, no independent confirmation, no normal class, no location labels. A fresh source-family test is required before claiming generalization.
